description:
Generates HeyGen avatar scripts and production prompts for Abstrekkt and FlashFusion content. Three input modes: topic-first, bullet-first, or notes/research-first. Always outputs a paired script + production prompt block covering Look selection, Voice Director tags, B-roll suggestions, pacing notes, and credit estimate. Brand: Kyle Rosebrook / Abstrekkt. Voice: direct, first-person, earned authority, no hype.
Activate when the user says: HeyGen script, write a script for HeyGen, generate an avatar script, script this for my avatar, video script, produce a HeyGen video, turn this into a HeyGen script, write a video for FlashFusion, Abstrekkt video, talking head script, brand video script, origin story video, explainer script, tutorial script for HeyGen, or any request to write a script for avatar delivery. Also activates on: topic → script, notes → video, bullets → video, research → script, write me a 90 second, write me a 60 second.
